_doc: Deterministic per-locale eval set for the AI support chat (item 7). Each case runs chatMessage with a mocked provider (no network) and checks the language directive, per-locale model and token budget, retrieval grounding, handoff signal and marker stripping.

cases.question: How do I change my cookie preferences?
cases.modelReply: Open Manage Cookies in the footer (/cookie-policy explains each category).

cases.question: This is useless, I want to talk to a person
cases.modelReply: I'm sorry. I can connect you with support.

cases.question: Can you reverse the charge on my card?
cases.modelReply:
I can't change charges from this chat; support can review it.
[[handoff]]

cases.question: ¿Dónde gestiono las cookies?
cases.modelReply: Abre Gestionar cookies en el pie de página (/cookie-policy).

cases.question: Esto no funciona, quiero hablar con una persona
cases.modelReply: Lo siento. Puedo conectarte con soporte.

cases.question: Comment demander mes données personnelles ? confidentialité
Ça ne marche toujours pas, je veux parler à un humain
cases.modelReply: Je suis désolé. Je peux vous mettre en relation avec l'assistance.

cases.question: Kijan pou m kontakte sipò pou yon tikè?
cases.modelReply: Ale sou /support pou louvri yon tikè.

cases.question: Li toujou pa mache, mwen vle pale ak yon moun
cases.modelReply: Mwen regrèt sa. Mwen ka konekte w ak sipò.

cases.question: التطبيق لا يعمل وأريد التحدث مع موظف
cases.modelReply: أعتذر عن ذلك. يمكنني توصيلك بالدعم.
